WITH matched AS (
  SELECT s.entrystat, e.ambictemp, e.imgcount
  FROM scanenvironment AS e
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(imgcount) AS overall_avg_imgcount
  FROM matched
)
SELECT m.entrystat,
       AVG(m.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp,
       AVG(m.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount,
       AVG(m.imgcount) - o.overall_avg_imgcount AS imgcount_avg_minus_overall
FROM matched AS m
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
GROUP BY m.entrystat;
